messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: runtime-euw P1 - widespread model warmup failures + repeated GPU OOMs observed across eu-west-2 pool. >40% of load-model calls failing. Auto-escalate to oncall.

rachel.lin: oncall ack. Jumping in. Dashboard shows a spike in warmup compile tasks and node reboots on gpu-eu-12 and gpu-eu-13.

arjun.patel: Warmup logs showing two consistent errors: artifact unpack deserializers failing with 'unexpected EOF' and our compile worker hitting a 100s timeout then pod eviction.

maya.soto: Example excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z warmup[pid=4482]: artifact deserialize error: EOF while decoding header (bundle=bundle-20260310, shard=9)
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z warmup[pid=4482]: falling back to compile path for fused_ops_v3
2026-03-15T10:02:14Z runtime[pid=4487]: nvidia: allocation failed: out of memory when allocating 3.6G device=0
2026-03-15T10:03:52Z compile: compile worker exceeded 100s timeout; aborting and OOM observed
```

ben_ops: I'm seeing kernel recoveries in dmesg and a handful of GPU resets. Some nodes are flapping under compile pressure.

cs-luke: Customer impact: Streamly (hosted) and NovaDocs (Dedicated) reporting 5xx/timeouts. Streamly already opened a priority ticket. NovaDocs is impacted on their Dedicated pool.

arjun.patel: Quick mitigations I'll put in place: 1) toggle off on-the-fly compilation cluster-wide (CONFIG_ALLOW_COMPILE=false) to prevent compile storms, 2) enable CPU/fallback-model routing for any new load-model calls (route->model-fallback-cpu) so we don't block customer requests, 3) set artifact quarantine for bundle-20260310 pending verification.

deploy-bot: Action: config change requested for runtime-euw: CONFIG_ALLOW_COMPILE=false; rollout beginning (batch 20%).

rachel.lin: Also enabling serve-stale-cache for generation routes to return cached responses when available and avoid triggering warmup. Pushing header-based opt-in for CS teams.

maya.soto: Warmup investigator note: artifact bundle-20260310 shows sporadic multipart read errors when fetching certain shards. Could be bad upload or S3 network blips. Opening ticket with S3.

arjun.patel: I'm issuing targeted cache-evict for shards 9 and 10 on affected nodes and forcing re-fetch using verified sha256 from origin. Staggering re-fetch across nodes with a 30-90s randomized jitter to avoid simultaneous compile attempts.

ben_ops: Restarting containerd on gpu-eu-12 and gpu-eu-13 to clear potential driver state. If nodes fail to stabilize we'll cordon and replace.

deploy-bot: Cache-evict executed: nodes: gpu-eu-12,gpu-eu-13; re-fetch jobs enqueued with jitter. Config rollout at 40%.

maya.soto: After disabling compile, we observed immediate reduction in new OOMs. However some in-flight pods still crashed; we are draining and letting them restart with CONFIG_ALLOW_COMPILE=false to serve from CPU fallback.

cs-luke: Notified Streamly and NovaDocs with mitigation steps and ETA ~45m. Streamly asked for a temporary reroute to ap-south-1; provided headers and a short runbook.

arjun.patel: Follow-ups: 1) run artifact integrity check across the artifact pipeline to catch bad multipart uploads, 2) lower compile timeout to 45s to fail fast on hung builds, 3) add pre-unpack checksum verification to warmup agent.

build-bot: Note: created ticket BUILD-1234 to add pre-unpack checksum and BUILD-1235 to add adaptive compile backoff.

rachel.lin: Handoff plan: I'll remain incident lead for 30m and then hand to ben_ops at 10:11 UTC for monitoring. Leaving detailed runbook notes and checklist in incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/4372104321

ben_ops: Acknowledged for handoff. Will monitor node health and customer tickets overnight.

arjun.patel: Root cause hypothesis: corrupted artifact shards (multipart read failure) triggered fallback compilation on many nodes; concurrent compiles saturated GPU memory and triggered OOMs and driver recoveries.

maya.soto: Short-term fixes worked: turning off compile and routing to CPU fallback dropped 5xx from ~46% -> ~9% on affected routes. Still doing artifact verification and node rotation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 -> P2. Active mitigations applied. Next update in 30m or on status change. :white_check_mark:

rachel.lin: Handing to ben_ops at 4372104670. Leaving checklist in the runbook and contact list for CS/SE. :wave:

ben_ops: Taking over. Will continue monitoring logs, follow up on S3 ticket, and coordinate node replacements if needed. Ping #eng-oncall for urgent escalation.
